system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: N/A, this mutation does not replace another feature.

When you gain this feature, you instinctually learn the Full Sage: Nature Transfiguration Hijutsu. This does not count against your known jutsu limit.

When you enter Feral Mania, you automatically cast the Full Sage: Nature Transfiguration as part of gaining the condition. When you cast Full Sage: Nature Transfiguration Hijutsu, you immediately enter Feral Mania as part of that jutsu’s casting.
